verdict.rationale: The pack only lists a bare "Payouts API" page title. Nothing describes controlling the payout schedule or breaking each payout down into its charges, fees, and refunds. The sales-report marketing line covers sales reconciliation in general, not payout composition, so neither part of the story is evidenced.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
